correctness.rationale: A complete logical proof reduces every smooth exact-B quartic to a perfect matching via residual intersection roots on Fano lines and unique tangents. There are exactly 24 matchings; rank 14 of every matching’s binary 14-by-15 matrix proves uniqueness and F4-to-F2 descent. The 168 projective Fano maps are transitive. Exact Groebner unit ideals on 3 affine charts prove the representative geometrically smooth; its F4-rational locus is exactly seven points; transitivity transfers both. Classical PGL group orders yield 360 Baer subplanes, 8640 curves, and stabilizer 7. Two independently implemented programs replay the finite certificates; point enumeration alone is not used to certify geometric smoothness. Smooth cubic impossibility from 5 collinear triples versus 7 Fano lines is separately proved and a direct GF4 cubic census checks the stronger absence of any cubic exact-B equation.

value.rationale: The full exact rational-point-set classification is of the smallest nontrivial blocking configuration in PG(2,4). It yields an unexpected extension-field descent rigidity, canonical Heawood matching model, complete 8640-member orbit, sharp minimal degree and precise stabilizer; these structural implications matter beyond recomputing the known 24 F2 filling quartics. It is a natural complete genus-3 boundary case, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
